verdict.rationale: Finix's own docs describe separate Sandbox and Live accounts, each with its own API credentials. A dedicated test environment simulates live payments, including test card payments, fee schemas and payout schedules, so testing stays off production data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documented detail on sandbox data isolation, test fixtures and limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Finix provides separate Sandbox and Live accounts, along with the corresponding API credentials to access the Finix API.
Finix’s test environment allows you to simulate a live payments experience. Test card payments, configure fees schemas, set payout schedules, and more.
